# @netblink/vue-components

A Vue 3 component library for Laravel + Inertia applications. Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript,
built on [reka-ui](https://reka-ui.com) primitives. Dark mode is opt-in.

This file is written for AI coding assistants. It is the fastest path from "build me a settings
page with this library" to correct, idiomatic code.

## Install

```bash
npm install @netblink/vue-components
```

`vue` is the only required peer. FontAwesome and `@iconify/vue` are optional peers, needed only to
route icons through those providers. reka-ui and everything else is bundled, so do not tell the
user to install it.

## Register

```js
// resources/js/app.js
import { createApp, h } from 'vue';
import { createInertiaApp, router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import Componentsnb, { setInertiaRouter, setInertiaPage } from '@netblink/vue-components';
import '@netblink/vue-components/style.css';

createInertiaApp({
    setup({ el, App, props, plugin }) {
        createApp({ render: () => h(App, props) })
            .use(plugin)
            // darkMode: false (default) | 'class' | 'system'
            .use(Componentsnb, { darkMode: 'class' })
            .mount(el);

        // Components that navigate or read page props need these once.
        setInertiaRouter(router);
        setInertiaPage(usePage());
    },
});
```

`style.css` above holds the components' scoped styles. The Tailwind side (tokens, keyframes,
utilities and an `@source` for the built components, which Tailwind v4 would otherwise skip in
`node_modules`) comes from `theme.css`. Your own stylesheet:

```css
/* resources/css/app.css */
@import 'tailwindcss';
@import '@netblink/vue-components/theme.css';
@plugin '@tailwindcss/forms';

/* Opt-in: activates `dark:` utilities when `.dark` is on <html>. */
/* Drop this line to use the default `prefers-color-scheme` behaviour. */
@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));
```

## The single most important convention: `:form` + `field`

Every form control integrates directly with Inertia's `useForm`. Pass the form object and the
field name, the component then owns its own value binding, label, and validation error display.
**Prefer this over `v-model`.** It is the idiomatic usage across all consuming apps.

```vue
<script setup>
import { useForm } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
const form = useForm({ name: '', email: '', role: '', notes: '' });
</script>

<template>
    <form @submit.prevent="form.post(route('users.store'))" class="space-y-4">
        <!-- label is auto-derived from the field name; errors render automatically -->
        <Input :form="form" field="name" label="Full name" required />
        <Input :form="form" field="email" type="email" />

        <Select :form="form" field="role" label="Role" :options="[{ value: 'admin', label: 'Admin' }, { value: 'editor', label: 'Editor' }]" />
        <Textarea :form="form" field="notes" :rows="3" />
        <Checkbox :form="form" field="terms" rightDescription="I agree to the terms" />

        <!-- SubmitButton reads form.processing itself: disables + spinner, no extra wiring -->
        <SubmitButton :form="form">Create user</SubmitButton>
    </form>
</template>
```

`v-model` is supported on every control for non-Inertia use:

```vue
<Input v-model="query" type="search" noLabel placeholder="Search…" />
<Switch v-model="enabled" noLabel rightDescription="Enable notifications" />
```

## Icons

`app.use(Componentsnb)` installs a default icon registry, so icons work with no configuration:
components draw their chevrons, close buttons and status icons from inline SVGs that ship with the
package. `$whatsapp` is the one alias with no default.

Use `NbIcon` for your own icons. Size it with the **`size` prop**, never with `h-*`/`w-*` classes,
those fight the component's own wrapper and leave the glyph at its default size.

```vue
<script setup>
import { NbIcon } from '@netblink/vue-components';
import { faPlus } from '@fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons';
</script>

<template>
    <NbIcon :name="faPlus" size="sm" />       <!-- sm md lg xl 2xl 3x, or a number/CSS length -->
    <NbIcon name="$close" size="lg" />        <!-- $-prefixed aliases resolve from the registry -->
</template>
```

## Buttons

`PrimaryButton`, `SecondaryButton`, `DangerButton`, `WarningButton`, `InfoButton`, `SuccessButton`
are thin wrappers over `Button`. Use `Button` with `theme` when the theme is dynamic. `LinkButton`
renders an anchor (or an Inertia `Link` when given `method`/`data`) with the same themes.
`SubmitButton` adds the loading state.

```vue
<PrimaryButton size="sm" @click="open = true">New</PrimaryButton>
<Button theme="danger" size="xs" @click="destroy">Delete</Button>
<LinkButton :href="route('users.index')" theme="secondary">Back</LinkButton>
<SubmitButton :loading="saving">Save</SubmitButton>
```

## Tables

`Table` renders its own horizontal-scroll wrapper and, given `:links`, its own pagination.
`Th` with `sortable` + `orderBy` handles sort links. On `Td`, the `label` prop supplies the
stacked mobile presentation, omit it and the table will not degrade on small screens.

```vue
<Table :links="users.meta.links" :total="users.meta.total" hover bordered>
    <Thead>
        <Th sortable orderBy="name">User</Th>
        <Th>Status</Th>
        <Th class="w-0"><span class="sr-only">Actions</span></Th>
    </Thead>
    <Tbody :data="users.data" emptyMessage="No users match your filters.">
        <Tr v-for="user in users.data" :key="user.id">
            <Td label="User">
                <div class="font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">{{ user.name }}</div>
                <div class="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">{{ user.email }}</div>
            </Td>
            <Td label="Status">{{ user.status }}</Td>
            <Td>
                <div class="flex justify-end gap-2">
                    <PrimaryButton size="xs" @click="edit(user)">Edit</PrimaryButton>
                    <Button theme="danger" size="xs" @click="destroy(user)">Delete</Button>
                </div>
            </Td>
        </Tr>
    </Tbody>
</Table>
```

## Modals

`NewModal` is preferred for new code (reka-ui `Dialog`, `v-model:open`). `Modal` is the older
variant kept for compatibility.

```vue
<NewModal v-model:open="showCreate" title="New user" description="Invite a teammate.">
    <div class="space-y-4">
        <Input :form="form" field="name" label="Full name" required />
    </div>
    <template #footer>
        <SecondaryButton @click="showCreate = false">Cancel</SecondaryButton>
        <PrimaryButton :disabled="form.processing" @click="form.post(route('users.store'))">Create</PrimaryButton>
    </template>
</NewModal>

<!-- resizable adds a drag handle at the bottom-right corner -->
<NewModal v-model:open="showNotes" resizable title="Release notes">…</NewModal>
```

## Toasts

Mount one `Toaster` in your layout, then raise toasts from anywhere with `useToast`.
`stack` collapses multiple toasts into a pile that fans out on hover.

```vue
<!-- layout -->
<Toaster position="bottom-right" stack />
```

```js
import { useToast } from '@netblink/vue-components';
const toast = useToast();
toast.success('Saved', { description: 'Your changes are live.' });
toast.error('Could not save');
```

## Dark mode

Every component ships dark variants; they activate under the strategy passed at registration
(`darkMode: 'class'` toggles on a `dark` class on `<html>`). When you write your own markup
around these components, pair every colour utility with a `dark:` variant:

| Light | Dark |
| --- | --- |
| `bg-white` | `dark:bg-gray-800` |
| `bg-gray-50` | `dark:bg-gray-900/40` |
| `text-gray-800` | `dark:text-gray-100` |
| `text-gray-600` | `dark:text-gray-400` |
| `border-gray-200` | `dark:border-gray-700` |

## Theming

Colours come from Tailwind v4 `@theme` tokens. Override the scale in your own CSS to re-brand
every component at once, use the numeric steps, not the bare alias:

```css
@theme {
    --color-primary-600: #0f766e; /* buttons, active states, focus rings */
    --color-primary-700: #115e59;
}
```

## Styling components (4.0)

Every component takes `class` for its root part and `:ui` for named parts. Each component's
**Parts** table below lists the part names and which part receives `class`. Classes you pass are
merged with tailwind-merge, so a clashing default is removed: no `!` needed.

```vue
<Input field="email" class="mb-8" :ui="{ label: 'text-xs uppercase', input: 'bg-gray-50' }" />
```

House styles and extra variant values go in the plugin options instead of wrapper components:

```js
app.use(Componentsnb, {
    ui: { Input: { input: 'border-gray-300 shadow-sm' }, SubmitButton: { root: 'rounded-full' } },
    variants: { Button: { theme: { brand: 'bg-violet-600 text-white hover:bg-violet-700' } } },
    motion: { level: 'smooth' }, // 'off' | 'simple' | 'smooth' | 'fancy'
    twMerge: { extend: { theme: { text: ['tiny'] } } }, // your own @theme tokens
});
```

Precedence, lowest first: library default, app `ui` config, instance `class`/`:ui`. `ui.Button`
also styles the Button inside PrimaryButton and SubmitButton. The 3.x override props
(`customClass`, `inputCustomClass`, `labelCustomClass`, ...) still work but are deprecated; write
`class` / `:ui` in new code. To change behaviour, wrap with `inheritAttrs: false`, extend the
exported props type (`InputProps`, `ButtonProps`, ...) and pass `$attrs`, props and slots through.

Motion: `useMotion()` returns `{ level, setLevel, reset }` for an end-user setting; a component
takes a `motion` prop for one instance. Each component's **Motion** line says what it does per level.

## Gotchas that cost real debugging time

- **`NavLink`, `ResponsiveNavLink` and `DropdownLink` swallow fallthrough `@click`.** They wrap the
  Inertia `Link`, which sets its own handler after spreading attrs. Put your handler on a wrapping
  element instead.
- **`Dropdown` portals its content to `<body>`.** Classes bound on `<Dropdown>` land on the floating
  panel, not the trigger; style the trigger with `:ui="{ trigger: '...' }"`.
- **`Td label` is required for mobile.** Without it a cell has no stacked small-screen rendering.
- **Size `NbIcon` with `size`, not `h-*`/`w-*`.**
- **Non-GET `LinkButton`/`DropdownLink` need `as="button"`** (`method="post"` on an anchor warns).
- **`NavCollapse` takes `name` and `open` only.** Older app code passes `parent`/`active`; those are
  ignored. Drive expansion with `:open`.
- **`NewModal` accepts `v-model:open`, `v-model` and `:show` + `@close`.** `v-model:open` is the
  documented and most common form. All three are declared, and `class` styles the dialog panel.

---

# Component API reference

Generated from source (99 exported components). Do not edit by hand, run `npm run docs:llms`.

### Alert

Inline `role="alert"` banner in success / error / warning / info variants, with a matching icon, an optional title and default-slot body. Set `dismissible` to add a close button; visibility is two-way bound through `v-model` and the show/hide is animated with a JS height+opacity transition rather than CSS classes.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `keyof AlertTypes` | `'info'` | The type/variant of the alert. Add your own through the `variants` config. |
| `title` | `string` | `undefined` | Alert title (optional) |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the alert can be dismissed |
| `modelValue` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the alert is initially visible |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Alert']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the alert box |
| `icon` | the type icon |
| `content` | the column holding title and body |
| `title` | the title |
| `body` | the slot wrapper |
| `dismiss` | the dismiss button |

**Motion:** `off`: appears and disappears instantly; `simple`: height and opacity, quickly, no movement; `smooth`: height and opacity with a small upward drift; `fancy`: the same on a longer spring.

### AttachmentList

name, size, a download link and, with `remove`, a remove button. Removing waits for your function (the row shows it's busy); if it fails the row stays and shows why. Rows animate in and out.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `AttachmentItem[]` | **required** | The files |
| `remove` | `(item: AttachmentItem) => Promise<void> \| void` | - | Delete a file; reject to keep it (the message is shown) |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['AttachmentList']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the list |
| `item` | one row |
| `thumbnail` | the picture or file icon |
| `name` | the file name |
| `meta` | the size or status line |
| `actions` | the download and remove buttons |

**Motion:** `off`: rows appear and disappear instantly; `simple`: rows fade quickly; `smooth`: rows fade and slide, the rest glide into place; `fancy`: the same on a spring.

### Avatar

A user picture, or their initials on a tinted disc when there is no picture or it fails to load. Initials come from the first letters of the first two words of `name`, and the tint is picked from `name` so the same person keeps the same colour everywhere. `status` adds a presence dot. Stack several with `AvatarGroup`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string \| null` | `undefined` | Picture URL |
| `name` | `string` | `''` | Full name: used for the initials, the tint and the accessible label |
| `alt` | `string` | `undefined` | Alternative text for the picture (defaults to `name`) |
| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` | Size |
| `status` | `'online' \| 'offline' \| 'busy' \| 'away'` | `undefined` | Presence dot |
| `square` | `boolean` | - | Rounded square instead of a circle |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Avatar']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the avatar |
| `image` | the picture |
| `initials` | the initials text |
| `status` | the presence dot |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### AvatarGroup

Overlapping row of `Avatar`s, each ringed so the overlap reads clearly. Past `max`, the rest collapse into a "+N" bubble. Avatars passed with `v-for` count one by one.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max` | `number` | `undefined` | How many avatars to show before the "+N" bubble |
| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` | Size of the "+N" bubble; match it to the avatars |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['AvatarGroup']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the row |
| `item` | the wrapper around each avatar |
| `more` | the "+N" bubble |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Badge

Small rounded label for statuses, counts and tags, in the shared colour vocabulary. Pass `status` (e.g. an order's status field) and the badge picks its colour from the status map (built-in words plus the app's `badge.statuses` plugin option) and shows the word capitalised, replacing hand-written `getStatusColor()` helpers. `dot` adds a leading status dot.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `keyof NbColorVariants` | `'neutral'` | Colour. Ignored when `status` is set. Add your own through the `variants` config. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'sm'` | Size |
| `dot` | `boolean` | - | Show a leading status dot |
| `status` | `string` | - | A status word: picks the colour from the status map and becomes the label |
| `label` | `string` | - | Text, when not using the default slot |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Badge']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the badge |
| `dot` | the leading dot |
| `label` | the text |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Breadcrumbs

Trail of links to the current page. Items with an `href` become Inertia links; the last item is the current page (`aria-current="page"`). `collapse` keeps long trails on one line on small screens by hiding the middle items behind an ellipsis. `PageHeader` renders one for you from its `breadcrumbs` prop.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `BreadcrumbItem[]` | **required** | The trail, first to current |
| `collapse` | `boolean` | `false` | On small screens show only the first and the last two items |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Breadcrumbs']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Slots:** `separator`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<nav>` landmark |
| `list` | the `<ol>` |
| `item` | each `<li>` |
| `link` | a link item |
| `current` | the current page |
| `separator` | the separator between items |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Button

Base Button component with theme support

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `theme` | `keyof ButtonThemes` | `'primary'` | Colour theme. Add your own through the `variants` config. |
| `type` | `ButtonType` | `'button'` | The button type (default: 'button') |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the button is disabled |
| `customClass` | `string` | `''` | Deprecated, use `class` |
| `size` | `keyof ButtonSizes` | `'md'` | Button size (default: 'md') |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Button']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<button>` element |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Card

a header (title, description and an `#actions` slot), a body and an optional footer band. Give it `href` to make the whole card an Inertia link, or `clickable` for a keyboard-reachable button card; `selected` marks the chosen one in a picker. Lighter than `Section`, which has a full header band and is meant for page sections.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | `undefined` | Title in the header |
| `description` | `string` | `undefined` | Text under the title |
| `href` | `string` | `undefined` | Make the whole card an Inertia link |
| `clickable` | `boolean` | `false` | Make the card a button (emits `click`, reachable with Tab, Enter and Space) |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Mark the card as the selected one |
| `hover` | `boolean` | `false` | Hover lift and border even when not interactive |
| `padding` | `'none' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Inner spacing |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Card']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `actions`, `default`, `footer`, `header`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the card |
| `header` | the row holding title, description and actions |
| `title` | the title |
| `description` | the text under the title |
| `actions` | the right-hand actions slot |
| `body` | the default slot wrapper |
| `footer` | the footer band |

**Motion:** `off`: hover and selection change instantly; `simple`: border and shadow fade on hover; `smooth`: border and shadow fade on hover; `fancy`: interactive cards also lift slightly on hover.

### Checkbox

Single checkbox with label, sublabel, tooltip and error message, plus optional descriptive text on either side of the box. Its model is a boolean on its own, or an array of values when `value` is set so several checkboxes can share one field; it binds through `v-model` or the Inertia `:form` + `field` pattern. `<Input type="checkbox">` renders this, so use it directly only when bypassing `Input`.

**v-model:** `v-model`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `boolean \| any[]` | `false` | The checked state - can be boolean for single checkbox or array for multiple |
| `value` | `any` | `null` | The value of the checkbox when used in arrays |
| `customClass` | `string` | `''` | Deprecated, use `:ui="{ input: '...' }"` |
| `id` | `string` | `''` | ID attribute for the checkbox |
| `field` | `string` | `undefined` | Form object containing field values and errors */ form?: { [key: string]: any; errors?: { [key: string]: string }; }; /** Field name for form binding |
| `label` | `string` | `undefined` | Label text displayed next to checkbox |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the field is required |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the checkbox is disabled |
| `noLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to hide the label |
| `tooltip` | `string` | `undefined` | Tooltip text shown next to label |
| `modelValue` | `boolean \| any[]` | `undefined` | Direct value binding |
| `name` | `string` | `undefined` | Name attribute for the input |
| `sublabel` | `string` | `undefined` | Sub-label text |
| `leftDescription` | `string \| boolean` | `false` | Text shown to the left of the checkbox |
| `rightDescription` | `string \| boolean` | `'Enable'` | Text shown to the right of the checkbox |
| `labelCustomClass` | `string` | `''` | Deprecated, use `:ui="{ label: '...' }"` |
| `error` | `string` | `undefined` | Custom error message |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Checkbox']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the field wrapper |
| `label` | the `InputLabel` above the checkbox |
| `field` | the clickable row holding the box and its descriptions |
| `description` | the left and right description text |
| `input` | the checkbox `<input>` |
| `error` | the `InputError` |

**Motion:** `off`: the box ticks and the error appears instantly; `simple`: the box ticks instantly; `smooth`: the box colour fades, the error grows in and out; `fancy`: the tick pops on a spring.

### CodePreview

Read-only code block with a header bar showing a filename and a copy-to-clipboard button. Takes `code` as an array of lines (joined with newlines), so snippets can be written as string arrays in docs pages; it does not highlight syntax, only sets a `language-*` class on the `<code>` element.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `string[]` | **required** | Array of code lines to display |
| `language` | `string` | - | Optional language label shown in the header (e.g. "css", "vue") |
| `filename` | `string` | - | Optional filename shown in the header instead of "Code Example" |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['CodePreview']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the block |
| `header` | the header bar |
| `filename` | the filename text |
| `copy` | the `CopyButton` |
| `pre` | the `<pre>` holding the code |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### CollapsableSection

Card-shaped collapsible panel built on reka-ui `Collapsible`: a bordered box whose whole header row is the trigger, with a chevron that rotates when open. Reach for this when the disclosure *is* the container; use `Collapse` instead when you only want a "Show more" button toggling some content inside an existing layout.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `string` | `undefined` | Header text for the collapsible section |
| `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the section is initially open |
| `headerColor` | `string` | `undefined` | Background color for the header |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['CollapsableSection']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the bordered card |
| `trigger` | the header row that toggles the section |
| `header` | the heading text |
| `icon` | the chevron wrapper |
| `content` | the collapsing panel |
| `body` | the padded wrapper around the slot |

**Motion:** `off`: opens and closes instantly; `simple`: the content's height animates quickly; `smooth`: the content's height animates in and out, the chevron turns; `fancy`: the height opens on a spring.

### Collapse

Minimal show/hide disclosure built on reka-ui `Collapsible`, rendering a `SecondaryButton` whose label comes from the `button` tuple `[shown, hidden]` and can be replaced entirely via the `trigger` slot. Use this for inline "Show more" toggles; use `CollapsableSection` when you want a full bordered card with a header bar.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the collapse is initially open |
| `button` | `[string, string]` | `() => ['Show more', 'Show less'] as [string, string]` | Button text for open and closed states [show, hide] |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Collapse']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`, `trigger`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the collapsible wrapper; `class` lands here |
| `trigger` | the `SecondaryButton`; other attrs land here |
| `label` | the button text |
| `icon` | the chevron in the button |
| `content` | the collapsing panel |
| `body` | the spacing wrapper around the slot |

**Motion:** `off`: opens and closes instantly; `simple`: the content's height animates quickly; `smooth`: the content's height animates in and out, the chevron turns; `fancy`: the height opens on a spring.

### ConfirmDialog

Renders the questions asked with `confirm()` / `useConfirm()`, one at a time. `<Toaster />` already includes one, so most apps never place it themselves; mount it directly only in an app without a Toaster. If several are mounted, the first one answers.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['ConfirmDialog']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the dialog panel (NewModal content) |
| `actions` | the button row |

**Motion:** `off`: opens and closes instantly; `simple`: a quick fade; `smooth`: the dialog fades and scales in, as NewModal does; `fancy`: the dialog grows out of the button that asked.

### ContentLoader

Shows a placeholder (`#loading`, usually a Skeleton) while `loading` is true and the real content once it is false, cross-fading between them and easing the height change instead of popping. `delay` keeps fast loads from flashing the placeholder: it only appears once loading has lasted that long.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | `boolean` | **required** | Show the placeholder instead of the content |
| `delay` | `number` | - | Wait this long (ms) before showing the placeholder, so quick loads don't flash it |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['ContentLoader']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`, `loading`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the wrapper (marked `aria-busy` while the placeholder shows) |
| `loading` | the placeholder layer |
| `content` | the content layer |

**Motion:** `off`: the placeholder and content swap instantly; `simple`: a quick cross-fade; `smooth`: a cross-fade, and the height eases to the new content; `fancy`: the same with a soft rise on the content.

### CopyButton

the icon turns into a check and screen readers hear "Copied". Renders an `IconButton` by default; put your own button in the default slot (it receives `copy` and `copied`). Falls back to a hidden textarea where the Clipboard API is unavailable (plain-HTTP pages).

| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'sm'` | Size of the default button |
| `theme` | `'ghost' \| 'secondary' \| 'primary'` | `'ghost'` | Theme of the default button |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['CopyButton']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the wrapper |
| `icon` | the copy or check icon (default button) |
| `status` | the visually hidden live region |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### DataTile

### DottedCarousel

Horizontal snap-scroll carousel with dot navigation underneath. Each top-level child of the default slot becomes a slide, so mark each with `class="min-w-full snap-start"` for the snapping to line up; the dot count is read from the DOM and kept in sync with a MutationObserver, and clicking a dot scrolls smoothly to that slide.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `padding` | `number` | `0` | Outer padding offset applied to the scroll math when clicking a dot |
| `gap` | `number` | `20` | Pixel gap between slides |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['DottedCarousel']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the wrapper |
| `track` | the snap-scrolling slide row |
| `dots` | the dot row |
| `indicator` | the active dot that slides between positions |
| `dot` | each dot |

**Motion:** `off`: the active dot jumps; `simple`: the active dot jumps; `smooth`: the active dot slides to the current slide; `fancy`: the active dot slides on a spring.

### Dropdown

menu popover built on reka-ui's `DropdownMenu` primitives. Provide a `#trigger` slot for the toggle element and a `#content` slot for the menu items (typically `DropdownLink` / `DropdownSeparator`). All non-listed attrs are forwarded to the underlying `DropdownMenuContent`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | `Align` | `AlignValue.START` | Where to anchor the menu relative to the trigger |
| `alignOffset` | `number` | `5` | Pixel offset from the alignment point |
| `openOnHover` | `boolean` | `false` | Open on hover instead of click |
| `hoverDelay` | `number` | `150` | Delay before closing on mouse leave (only when openOnHover is true) |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Dropdown']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `content`, menu items, `trigger`, element that opens the menu

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `content`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `trigger` | the trigger `<button>` around the `#trigger` slot |
| `content` | the menu panel; `class` and other attrs land here |

**Motion:** `off`: opens and closes instantly; `simple`: quick fade in and out; `smooth`: fades in with a small slide away from the trigger, fades out; `fancy`: pops out of the trigger on a spring, zooms out on close.

### FileDropZoneInput

Dashed drag-and-drop area for picking files, built on `vue3-dropzone`, with click-to- browse, an `accept` filter and optional multiple selection. Three ways to use it: - `:form` + `field`: the chosen File objects go straight onto the Inertia form, which uploads them with the rest of the form (rejections and `form.errors` show inline). - `v-model`: the chosen `File` (or `File[]` with `multiple`), without an Inertia form. - `:upload`: each file uploads as soon as it is picked, with per-file progress and retry. Whatever the function resolves to (a server token, an id) goes into `v-model`; `initialFiles` lists files already on the server and `:remove` deletes them. The file list (with previews and remove buttons) is on by default for `v-model` and `:upload`, and opt-in with `list` for `:form` + `field`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accept` | `string \| string[]` | `'image/*'` | File types the picker and drop accept |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Allow several files |
| `label` | `string` | - |  |
| `form` | `Record<string, any>` | `undefined` | Inertia form to write the files onto (with `field`) |
| `field` | `string` | `undefined` | Form field name |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `modelValue` | `unknown` | `undefined` | Picked file(s), or uploaded values with `:upload` |
| `upload` | `FileDropUpload` | `undefined` | Upload each file as soon as it is picked |
| `remove` | `(value: unknown) => Promise<void> \| void` | `undefined` | Delete an uploaded or initial file on the server; rejecting keeps it in the list |
| `initialFiles` | `FileDropInitialFile[]` | `() => []` | Files already stored, shown in the list (with `:upload`) |
| `maxSize` | `number` | `undefined` | Largest accepted file, in MB |
| `maxFiles` | `number` | `undefined` | Most files accepted at once |
| `list` | `boolean` | `undefined` | Show the file list (default on for `v-model` and `:upload`, off for `:form` + `field`) |
| `preview` | `boolean` | `true` | Thumbnails for images in the list |
| `FileDropCustomClass` | `string` | - | Deprecated, use `:ui="{ zone: '...' }"` |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['FileDropZoneInput']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the wrapper `<div>` |
| `zone` | the dashed drop area |
| `content` | the clickable area inside it |
| `label` | the label text |
| `list` | the list of picked files |
| `file` | each file row |
| `thumb` | the image preview or file icon |
| `name` | the file name and size |
| `progress` | the upload `Progress` |
| `remove` | the remove `IconButton` |
| `error` | the `InputError` |

**Motion:** `off`: files appear and leave the list instantly; `simple`: files fade in and out; `smooth`: files slide in and the list closes up smoothly; `fancy`: the same, springier.

### GravatarImg

`<img>` pointing at the Gravatar for an email. MD5-hashes the (trimmed, lowercased) email and builds a `https://www.gravatar.com/avatar/<hash>?s=<size>` URL. The `alt` text is derived from the email - no `alt` prop. Pair with utility classes like `rounded-full` to shape the image; the component doesn't apply any.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | `string` | **required** | Email - md5-hashed (after trim + lowercase) for the Gravatar lookup |
| `size` | `number` | `100` | Pixel size requested from Gravatar (the `s=` query parameter) |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['GravatarImg']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<img>` |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### IconButton

close buttons, row actions, toolbar tools. `label` is required and becomes the accessible name (and the hover title), since an icon alone tells a screen reader nothing. `ghost` is the quiet toolbar look used by the library's own close buttons; the filled themes match `Button`. Pass `href` to render an Inertia link instead.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `label` | `string` | **required** | What the button does, for screen readers and the hover title. Required. |
| `theme` | `'ghost' \| 'ghost-danger' \| 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'danger' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'info'` | `'ghost'` | Look. Add your own through the `variants` config. |
| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Size |
| `href` | `string` | `undefined` | Render an Inertia link to this URL instead of a button |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disabled |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | `'button'` | Button type |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['IconButton']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the button or link |
| `icon` | the icon |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Images

Self-contained image gallery and uploader for a given record: it shows the existing `images`, and when `canUpload` is set adds a `vue3-dropzone` area that previews picked files and POSTs them as multipart form data to `endPoint` with `item_type`/`item_id`, using its own Inertia form. Unlike `FileDropZoneInput`, which only stages files on a form you own, this component performs the upload itself.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `images` | `Array<{ id: number \| string` | `() => []` | Existing images, `{ id, url }[]` |
| `url` | `string }>` | **required** |  |
| `itemType` | `string` | - |  |
| `itemId` | `number` | - |  |
| `canUpload` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `endPoint` | `string` | `'images.store'` |  |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Images']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the upload `<form>` |
| `zone` | the dashed drop area |
| `content` | the clickable area inside it |
| `previews` | the row of picked images |
| `preview` | one picked image |
| `remove` | the red remove badge on a preview |
| `button` | the Upload button |
| `status` | the "Images uploaded." message |
| `error` | the `InputError` |
| `gallery` | the existing images below the form |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### ImpersonationBanner

### Input

The all-in-one form control and the default choice for any field: it renders the label, sublabel, tooltip and error message around the input and switches implementation on the `type` prop, delegating to `Textarea`, `Switch`, `Checkbox`, a native select, a password field with a show/hide toggle, or a plain input with addon/submit/WhatsApp actions. Binds either through `v-model` or the Inertia `:form` + `field` pattern, pulling validation errors straight off `form.errors`. `TextInput` is the bare unstyled-chrome `<input>` underneath, use it only when you are building your own field layout.

**v-model:** `v-model`

**Slots:** `default`, `leftDescription`, `rightDescription`, `submit`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the field wrapper (for textarea, switch and checkbox, that component's root) |
| `label` | the `InputLabel` |
| `group` | the row holding the input with its addon, buttons or password toggle |
| `input` | the control itself |
| `addon` | the leading addon text |
| `button` | the submit and WhatsApp buttons |
| `toggle` | the password show/hide button |
| `error` | the `InputError` |

**Motion:** `off`: the error appears instantly; `simple`: the error appears instantly; `smooth`: the error grows in and out; `fancy`: the error grows in on a spring.

| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['InputError']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the wrapper, hidden while there is no message |
| `message` | the red `<p>` |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

Mostly used internally by `InputWrapper`; reach for it directly only when hand-building a field rather than using `Input`.

| `customClass` | `string` | - | Deprecated, use `class` |
| `tooltip` | `string` | - |  |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['InputLabel']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### LinkDropdownButton

Primary-styled button that opens a reka-ui dropdown menu of links, rendering the slot content inside its own `<ul>`. Fill it with `LinkDropdownButtonItem` children, which supply the matching `<li>`; use `Dropdown` instead when you need an arbitrary trigger element rather than this fixed button.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | `Align` | `AlignValue.START` | Alignment of the dropdown content relative to trigger |
| `alignOffset` | `number` | `5` | Offset from the alignment position |
| `title` | `string` | `undefined` | Title text displayed on the button |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['LinkDropdownButton']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `content`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `trigger` | the primary-styled `<button>` |
| `icon` | the chevron in the button |
| `content` | the menu panel; `class` and other attrs land here |
| `list` | the `<ul>` around the items |

**Motion:** `off`: opens and closes instantly; `simple`: quick fade in and out; `smooth`: fades in with a small slide away from the trigger, fades out, the chevron turns; `fancy`: pops out of the trigger on a spring, zooms out on close.

### LinkDropdownButtonItem

One entry in a `LinkDropdownButton` menu. It renders its own `<li>` wrapping a plain `<a href>` with the menu's hover/focus styling, so it does a full page load rather than an Inertia visit, use `DropdownLink` when you want client-side navigation.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | `string` | - | The URL to navigate to |
| `title` | `string` | - | The title/text to display |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['LinkDropdownButtonItem']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<li>` |
| `link` | the `<a>` |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### LogsContent

Renders a paginated Laravel activity-log payload as a vertical timeline, with a per-entry icon, the formatted event, old → new value diffs and the causer's name. It shows a `Spinner` while `logs` is undefined and appends its own `Pagination` from `logs.links`; the causer is linked via `causerRoute` through the host app's Ziggy `route()` helper and degrades to plain text when that route or helper is missing.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `logs` | `Record<string, any>` | - | Laravel-style paginated result `{ total, data[], links? }` |
| `causerRoute` | `string \| null` | `'users.show'` | Route name used to link a log entry's causer. Set to null to never link. |
| `emptyMessage` | `string` | `'No Data'` | Shown when there are no entries. Default `'No Data'` |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['LogsContent']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Slots:** `empty`, replaces the empty message

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the wrapper (or the spinner row while loading) |
| `empty` | the line shown when there are no entries |
| `list` | the timeline `<ol>` |
| `marker` | the round icon on the timeline |
| `card` | each entry's card |
| `meta` | the event and date row |
| `change` | each "field: old -> new" line |
| `details` | the description details |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Modal

teleported to `<body>`, with its own backdrop, escape/backdrop-click closing, body-scroll locking and optional drag-resize handles, driven by `:show` + `@close`. Everything (header, body and footer) goes in the single default slot. Deprecated: use `NewModal`. It accepts the same props and `:show` + `@close`, so renaming the tag is enough, except: `modalCustomClass` becomes `class`, `alignCenter` is NewModal's default (add `align-top` where it was absent to keep the old position), and add `:padded="false"` when the slot already brings its own padding.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `show` | `boolean` | `false` | visibility, paired with `@close` (there is no `update:show`, so `v-model:show` can't close it) |
| `maxWidth` | `string` | `'2xl'` | sm \| md \| lg \| xl \| 2xl-7xl \| '50%' \| '60%' \| '75%' \| '80%' \| '90%' \| '95%' |
| `closeable` | `boolean` | `true` | allow closing via backdrop click or Escape key |
| `hideOverflow` | `boolean` | `true` | apply overflow-hidden to the modal container |
| `backdropDuration` | `number` | `200` | backdrop fade duration (ms) |
| `modalDuration` | `number` | `200` | modal enter/leave duration (ms) |
| `alignCenter` | `boolean` | `false` | vertically center the modal (default top-aligns) |
| `showBorder` | `boolean` | `false` | add the brand-coloured border around the panel |
| `modalCustomClass` | `string` | `''` | Deprecated, use `class` |
| `backdropCustomClass` | `string` | `''` | Deprecated, use `:ui="{ overlay: '...' }"` |
| `resizable` | `boolean` | `false` | render edge/corner handles so the user can resize the modal |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Modal']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `content`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the fixed full-screen container |
| `overlay` | the backdrop |
| `content` | the panel; `class` lands here |

**Motion:** `off`: opens and closes instantly; `simple`: backdrop and panel only fade; `smooth`: backdrop fades, the panel fades and scales in (the 3.x behaviour); `fancy`: same as smooth.

### NbTransition

`<Transition>` with ready-made presets that follow the motion levels and the theme's motion tokens: `fade`, `slide-up`, `slide-down`, `scale`, and `collapse` (height). Use it for "Saved." flashes, page transitions in a layout (`mode="out-in"`), or anything shown with `v-if`/`v-show`. Prefixed `Nb` so it doesn't clash with Vue's own `<Transition>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `'fade' \| 'slide-up' \| 'slide-down' \| 'scale' \| 'collapse'` | `'fade'` | Animation |
| `mode` | `'in-out' \| 'out-in' \| 'default'` | `undefined` | Passed to `<Transition>`: `out-in` for swapping content such as pages |
| `appear` | `boolean` | `false` | Animate on first render too |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | `undefined` | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`

**Motion:** `off`: appears and disappears instantly; `simple`: a quick fade (collapse still animates its height); `smooth`: the chosen preset; `fancy`: a stronger, springier version of the preset.

### NbTransitionGroup

`<TransitionGroup>` for lists: items fade or slide in and out with the same presets as `NbTransition`, and from `smooth` up the remaining items glide to their new places when the list is filtered, sorted or changed. Give every child a stable `key`. Prefixed `Nb` so it doesn't clash with Vue's own component.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `'fade' \| 'slide-up' \| 'slide-down' \| 'scale'` | `'fade'` | Enter/leave animation for each item |
| `tag` | `string` | `'div'` | Element that wraps the list |
| `appear` | `boolean` | `false` | Animate the initial items too |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | `undefined` | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`

**Motion:** `off`: items appear, disappear and reorder instantly; `simple`: items fade quickly, the rest reorder instantly; `smooth`: the chosen preset, and moving items glide; `fancy`: a stronger preset, and moving items glide on a spring.

### NewModal

Accessible dialog built on reka-ui's headless `Dialog` primitives, and the one to use for new code. Open state is driven with `v-model:open`, and named header, description, footer and trigger slots sit alongside the default slot for body content. Covers every `Modal` prop too (`:show` + `@close`, `maxWidth`, `closeable`, ...), so a legacy `<Modal>` swaps over by renaming the tag. Forwards `$attrs` onto the underlying `DialogContent`, so accessibility props (`aria-*`, `role`) and custom classes reach the dialog panel itself.

**v-model:** `v-model:open`, `v-model`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | `undefined` | Title rendered in DialogTitle (overridden by the `header` slot) |
| `description` | `string` | `undefined` | Sub-title rendered in DialogDescription (overridden by the `description` slot) |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Open the dialog on mount |
| `resizable` | `boolean` | `false` | Let the user drag-resize the dialog from its bottom-right corner |
| `show` | `boolean` | `undefined` | Open state for `:show` + `@close` call sites carried over from `Modal`; `v-model:show` works too |
| `maxWidth` | `string` | `undefined` | sm \| md \| lg \| xl \| 2xl-7xl \| 50% \| 60% \| 75% \| 80% \| 90% \| 95%, or any CSS length. Default 600px |
| `closeable` | `boolean` | `true` | Allow closing via Escape, backdrop click and the close button |
| `hideOverflow` | `boolean` | `true` | Keep content inside the panel (scrolls when tall). Set false so non-portaled popups can spill out |
| `alignTop` | `boolean` | `false` | Top-align the dialog instead of centring it, so growing content doesn't make it jump |
| `showBorder` | `boolean` | `false` | Add the brand-coloured border around the panel |
| `padded` | `boolean` | `true` | Built-in panel padding. Set false when the slot brings its own (e.g. a `p-6` wrapper from `Modal`) |
| `backdropDuration` | `number` | `undefined` | Backdrop animation duration (ms), defaults to the theme motion tokens |
| `modalDuration` | `number` | `undefined` | Panel animation duration (ms), defaults to the theme motion tokens |
| `backdropCustomClass` | `string` | `''` | Deprecated, use `:ui="{ overlay: '...' }"` |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['NewModal']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`, body content, `description`, overrides the `description` prop, `footer`, right-aligned footer area, `header`, overrides the `title` prop, `trigger`, element that opens the dialog when clicked

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `content`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `overlay` | the backdrop |
| `content` | the dialog panel; `class` lands here |
| `title` | the `DialogTitle` |
| `description` | the `DialogDescription` |
| `spacer` | the gap under the title and description |
| `footer` | the footer row |
| `close` | the close button |

**Motion:** `off`: opens and closes instantly; `simple`: backdrop and panel fade quickly; `smooth`: backdrop fades, the panel slides up in and drops out; the panel animates its height when its content grows or shrinks; `fancy`: the panel grows out of the element that opened it and shrinks back into it on close.

### PageHeader

breadcrumbs, title, description and an `#actions` slot on the right, with a mobile "Back" link when `back` is set. `variant="bar"` is the compact bordered breadcrumb/actions bar many admin screens use instead of a title block. `sticky` (either variant) keeps it in view while scrolling; set the `--nb-sticky-offset` CSS variable to clear a fixed banner above it.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | `undefined` | Page title |
| `description` | `string` | `undefined` | Text under the title |
| `breadcrumbs` | `BreadcrumbItem[]` | `undefined` | Breadcrumb trail, first to current |
| `back` | `string` | `undefined` | URL for a "Back" link shown on small screens |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'bar'` | `'default'` | `default` title block or the compact bordered `bar` |
| `sticky` | `boolean` | `false` | Stick to the top while scrolling (offset by `--nb-sticky-offset`) |
| `backLabel` | `string` | `'Back'` | Label of the mobile back link |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['PageHeader']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Slots:** `actions`, `default`, `meta`, `title`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the header |
| `breadcrumbs` | the `Breadcrumbs` |
| `back` | the mobile "Back" link |
| `main` | the column holding breadcrumbs, title and description |
| `title` | the title |
| `description` | the text under the title |
| `meta` | the `#meta` slot wrapper |
| `actions` | the `#actions` slot wrapper |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Pagination

Pagination component for navigating through pages of data

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `links` | `PaginationLink[]` | **required** | Array of pagination link objects |
| `linkReturn` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to return links instead of navigating |
| `maxPagesToShow` | `number` | `20` | Maximum number of page links to display |
| `logs` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether this is used for logs pagination |
| `customLinkClass` | `string` | `''` | Deprecated, use `:ui="{ link: '...' }"` |
| `customActiveLinkClass` | `string` | `''` | Deprecated, use `:ui="{ activeLink: '...' }"` |
| `customListClass` | `string` | `''` | Deprecated, use `:ui="{ list: '...' }"` |
| `preserveScroll` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to preserve scroll position |
| `preserveState` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to preserve component state |
| `only` | `string[]` | `() => []` | Array of properties to preserve during navigation |
| `showPerPage` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to show per-page selector |
| `defaultPerPage` | `number` | `100` | Default number of items per page |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Pagination']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the wrapper |
| `list` | the `<ul>` of page links |
| `link` | each page link |
| `activeLink` | extra classes for the current page, on top of `link` |
| `disabledLink` | a link without a URL (previous/next at the ends) |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Progress

`value` out of `max`, with an optional label and percentage above it. `indeterminate` shows a sweeping bar for work of unknown length. Exposed as `role="progressbar"` with the current values.

| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Bar thickness |
| `label` | `string` | `undefined` | Text above the bar (also the accessible name) |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the percentage above the bar |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Unknown length: a sweeping bar instead of a fill |

| `value` | the percentage |

| `bar` | the coloured fill |

**Motion:** `off`: the fill jumps to the new width; `simple`: the fill jumps to the new width; `smooth`: the fill glides to the new width; `fancy`: the fill glides to the new width on a longer curve; all levels: the indeterminate sweep runs at every level, like Spinner.

### RadioButton

One radio option with its label. Render several sharing the same `name` (or the same `:form` + `field` pair) to form a group, selection is derived by comparing this option's `value` against the bound field, and choosing it writes straight back to the Inertia form. There is no wrapping fieldset or error display; add those yourself.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |

| `name` | `string` | `undefined` | Name attribute for grouping radio buttons |
| `value` | `string` | `undefined` | Value of the radio button |
| `isChecked` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the radio button is checked (deprecated - use modelValue) |
| `modelValue` | `string` | `undefined` | The current selected value (used with v-model) |
| `label` | `string` | `undefined` | Label text for the radio button |
| `field` | `string` | `undefined` | Form object containing field values and errors */ form?: { [key: string]: any; errors?: { [key: string]: string }; }; /** Field name for form binding |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['RadioButton']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the row wrapper |
| `input` | the radio `<input>` |
| `label` | the `<label>` |

**Motion:** `off`: the dot appears instantly; `simple`: the dot appears instantly; `smooth`: the colour fades; `fancy`: the dot pops on a spring.

### SearchSelect

Single-choice select with a type-to-filter box, built on `vue-search-select`'s `ModelListSelect` over a client-side `list` whose value/label keys you name via `optionValue`/`optionText`; the filter itself is overridable with `filterPredicate`. Binds via `v-model` or the Inertia `:form` + `field` pattern. Use `Select`/`SimpleSelect` when a plain dropdown will do, `Select2ajax` when options must be fetched from a server, and `SelectMultiple` or `RichSelect` when more than one value can be chosen.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `label` | `string` | - |  |
| `list` | `any[]` | **required** |  |
| `optionValue` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `optionText` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `optionDisabled` | `string` | - |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` | - |  |
| `field` | `string` | - |  |
| `form` | `Record<string, any>` | - |  |
| `modelValue` | `any` | - |  |
| `noLabel` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `noForm` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `filterPredicate` | `(option: string, term: string) => boolean` | `(option: string, term: string) => {` |  |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['SearchSelect']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the wrapper `<div>` |
| `label` | the `InputLabel` |
| `input` | the search select control |
| `error` | the `InputError` |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Select2ajax

Server-backed version of `SearchSelect`: it wraps that component and fills the option list by requesting `url` with the current search term, appending further pages as the user scrolls the dropdown to the bottom. Reach for it when the option set is too large to ship to the client; use `SearchSelect` for a static list, or `RichSelect` if you want API search plus multiple selection and grouping in one component.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `label` | `string` | - |  |
| `optionValue` | `string` | `'value'` |  |
| `optionText` | `string` | `'label'` |  |
| `optionDisabled` | `string` | `'disabled'` |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` | - |  |
| `field` | `string` | - |  |
| `form` | `Record<string, any>` | - |  |
| `modelValue` | `any` | - |  |
| `noLabel` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `noForm` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `url` | `string` | **required** | Endpoint queried with `term` and `page` |
| `queryParams` | `Record<string, any>` | - | Extra query parameters sent with every request |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Select2ajax']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the wrapper `<div>` (rendered by `SearchSelect`) |
| `label` | the `InputLabel` |
| `input` | the search select control |
| `error` | the `InputError` |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Skeleton

### Spinner

| Part | Element |

| `root` | the spinning ring |

**Motion:** all levels: keeps spinning at every level, including `off`: it is a status indicator.

### StarRating

Star rating, to show a score or to pick one. Read-only ratings can be fractional (3.5 fills half of the fourth star). Editable ratings are a radio group: click a star, or use the arrow keys, Home and End.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `max` | `number` | - | Number of stars |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | - | Display only (allows fractions) |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | - | Star size |
| `label` | `string` | - | Accessible name of the group, e.g. "Rate this order" |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['StarRating']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

| `star` | one star (a radio when editable) |
| `fill` | the filled part of a star |

**Motion:** `off`: stars fill instantly; `simple`: stars fill instantly; `smooth`: the fill fades in; `fancy`: the picked star pops on a spring.

### Stats

Responsive grid of clickable stat tiles used as quick filters above a table. Clicking a tile emits `updateSearch` with that tile's `name`, or `null` when the already-selected tile is clicked again to clear it. Which tile shows as selected is read from the Inertia page URL's query string (parameter named by `statusName`, default `status`), and falls back to all-unselected outside an Inertia app.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stats` | `StatItem[]` | **required** | `{ name, value, label? }[]` - label falls back to `name` for display |
| `statusName` | `string \| null` | `null` | query-string parameter used to compute the selected tile |
| `customContainerClass` | `string` | `''` | deprecated, use `class` |
| `customStatClass` | `string` | `''` | deprecated, use `:ui="{ stat: '...' }"` |
| `customStatLabelClass` | `string` | `''` | deprecated, use `:ui="{ label: '...' }"` |
| `customStatValueClass` | `string` | `''` | deprecated, use `:ui="{ value: '...' }"` |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Stats']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the grid |
| `stat` | each tile |
| `value` | the value section |
| `valueText` | the number |
| `label` | the label section |
| `labelText` | the label text |
| `underline` | the hover underline |
| `chip` | a stat's icon chip (when the stat has `chip`) |
| `trend` | a stat's change indicator (when the stat has `change`) |
| `ping` | a stat's live dot (when the stat has `live`) |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Stepper

Progress through a multi-step flow: numbered markers joined by rails that fill as steps complete. Give each step a `state`, or just pass `current` (0-based) and steps before it count as complete. `clickable` makes markers buttons that emit `select`, for wizards that allow jumping back. Horizontal or vertical.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | `StepperStep[]` | **required** | The steps in order |
| `current` | `number` | `0` | Index of the current step (0-based), used for steps without a `state` |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | Layout |
| `clickable` | `boolean` | `false` | Markers become buttons that emit `select` |
| `label` | `string` | `'Progress'` | Accessible name of the list |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Stepper']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<ol>` |
| `step` | each step |
| `marker` | the numbered or checked circle |
| `label` | the step name |
| `description` | the hint under the name |
| `connector` | the rail to the next step |

**Motion:** `off`: markers and rails change colour instantly; `simple`: markers and rails change colour instantly; `smooth`: markers and rails fade to their new colour; `fancy`: the same, and a newly completed marker pops.

### SubmitButton

### SubNav

Navigation between sibling pages (Inertia links) that looks like `Tabs`: `pills`, `underline` or a full-width `segmented` strip, with the same sliding active marker from `smooth` up. The active item is taken from each item's `active` flag, or matched against the current page URL (the longest matching `href` wins, so a section's sub-pages keep their parent highlighted). For switching panels on one page, use `Tabs`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `SubNavItem[]` | **required** | The links |
| `variant` | `'pills' \| 'underline' \| 'segmented'` | `'pills'` | Look |
| `label` | `string` | `'Section navigation'` | Accessible name of the navigation landmark |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['SubNav']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<nav>` landmark |
| `list` | the strip holding the links |
| `item` | each link |
| `badge` | the count next to a label |
| `indicator` | the sliding active marker (smooth and fancy motion only) |

**Motion:** `off`: the active marker moves instantly; `simple`: the active marker moves instantly; `smooth`: the active marker slides between items; `fancy`: the active marker slides on a spring.

### Tab

a single panel inside `<Tabs>`. `value` must match the `value` of the corresponding entry in the parent's `tabs` array. Content is only rendered while the tab is active.

### Table

Scroll container and `<table>` shell for the table primitives: compose `Thead`, `Th`, `Tbody`, `Tr` and `Td` inside its default slot, and it applies the striped / bordered / hover / sticky-header / size / variant styling plus a responsive wrapper. It renders its own `Pagination` from a Laravel paginator passed as `pagination` (or legacy `links`) and shows a "Found: n" count when `total` is given. Use `EnhancedTable` instead when you would rather declare `columns` and `data` and have the rows generated for you.

**Slots:** `default`, `pagination`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the outer wrapper |
| `count` | the "Found: n" line |
| `container` | the scroll container around the table |
| `table` | the `<table>` |
| `pagination` | the row holding the pagination |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### TableItemCard

Mobile-friendly card summarising one record, used as the small-screen fallback for a table row: it lays out an id, title, coloured pills, option links, a timestamp and a formatted amount, each of which can link via an explicit `href` or a Ziggy route name and degrades to plain text when the host app has no `route()` helper.

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the card |

### Tabs

tabbed panel switcher built on reka-ui's `Tabs` primitives. Declare the tab strip with `tabs`, then render one `<Tab>` per panel in the default slot. Keyboard navigation, roving focus and ARIA wiring come from reka-ui. ```vue <Tabs :tabs="[{ value: 'fa', label: 'FontAwesome' }, { value: 'hero', label: 'Heroicons' }]"> <Tab value="fa">…</Tab> <Tab value="hero">…</Tab> </Tabs> ```

**v-model:** `v-model`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tabs` | `TabItem[]` | **required** | `{ value, label, icon?, disabled?, badge? }[]` |
| `variant` | `keyof TabsVariants` | `'underline'` | Visual treatment. Add your own through the `variants` config. |
| `fitted` | `boolean` | `false` | stretch triggers to fill the strip width |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Tabs']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`, the `<Tab>` panels, `trigger`, custom trigger content; receives `{ tab, active }`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the tabs wrapper |
| `list` | the tab strip |
| `trigger` | each tab button |
| `icon` | the icon in a tab |
| `badge` | the count badge in a tab |
| `indicator` | the sliding active marker (smooth and fancy motion only) |

**Motion:** `off`: the active tab switches instantly; `simple`: colour change only, the marker jumps; `smooth`: the underline (or pill) slides to the new tab; `fancy`: the marker slides on a spring.

### Tbody

The `<tbody>` primitive, which also owns the table's loading and empty states: it shows `TrPlaceholder` skeleton rows while loading and a centred empty-state row (`emptyMessage`, or the `#empty` slot) when the data is empty. Pass `data` as an array, or as the string name of an Inertia prop, in which case it reads that prop and wraps the rows in Inertia's `<Deferred>` so deferred props stream in with the placeholder as fallback.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | New props |
| `data` | `TableRow[] \| string` | - |  |
| `emptyMessage` | `string` | `undefined` | Shown when `data` is empty. Default `'No records found'` |
| `loadingRows` | `number` | `3` |  |
| `responsive` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `hidePlaceholder` | `boolean` | `false` | Legacy props for backward compatibility |
| `hideNoRecordsMessage` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `recordsFromPagination` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `noRecordsMessage` | `string` | `undefined` | Deprecated, use `emptyMessage` |
| `ignoreDefer` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Tbody']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`, `empty`, replaces the empty message

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<tbody>` |
| `empty` | the `Td` showing the empty message |

**Motion:** `fancy`: rows glide to their new place when rows are added, removed or re-sorted, new rows fade in (override with `root.move`); all levels: below fancy, rows change in place; the loading skeleton pulses at every level.

### Td

A single body cell inside a `Tr`, handling alignment, width and no-wrap. When the table is responsive it becomes a stacked block on small screens, and a `label` prop prints that label before the value in that mobile layout only, the plain cell still renders from `sm` up.

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<td>` |
| `label` | the label printed before the value on small screens |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Textarea

### TextInput

### Th

Header cell for a `Thead` row. Set `sortable` together with `column` (or the legacy `orderBy`) to make it clickable: it shows asc/desc arrows reflecting the current order and delegates the actual sorting to the `useTableSort` composable, which drives an Inertia visit rather than sorting in place.
