### Thead

The `<thead>` primitive, holding a row of `Th` cells. In responsive mode it is hidden below `sm`, since `Tr`/`Td` switch to a stacked card layout with per-cell labels there; set `sticky` to pin the header cells while the table body scrolls.

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<thead>` |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Timeline

Chronological list of events, each with a coloured icon marker, a title, a time and an optional description. `line` (default) joins the markers with a rail; `cards` puts each event in a softly tinted row instead. Use the scoped `#item` slot to render your own event body.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `TimelineItem[]` | **required** | The events, in display order |
| `layout` | `'line' \| 'cards'` | `'line'` | Connected rail or tinted rows |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Timeline']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Slots:** `item`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<ol>` |
| `item` | each event |
| `marker` | the `IconCircle` |
| `connector` | the rail between markers (`line` layout) |
| `content` | the column holding the text |
| `title` | the title |
| `time` | the time |
| `description` | the description |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Toast

a single queued notification, rendered by `<Toaster>`. You very rarely mount this yourself; raise notifications with the `toast` helper and let the Toaster render them. It is exported so a host app can build a bespoke viewport if the shipped one doesn't fit. The `snackbar` variant is the same component in a different suit: one inverted bar sized to its content, Material-style, rather than a stacked card.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `item` | `ToastItem` | **required** | queue entry to render |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Toast']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the toast card or snackbar bar |
| `icon` | the status icon or spinner |
| `body` | the text column (a button when the toast is clickable) |
| `title` | the title line |
| `description` | the description line |
| `action` | the action button |
| `close` | the dismiss button |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### Toaster

the viewport that renders the notification queue. Mount exactly one, in your root layout, and never think about it again: ```vue <Toaster position="bottom-right" :duration="4000" /> ``` Everything about *where* and *how* notifications appear is configured here, so raising one stays a one-liner from anywhere in the app. It also listens for `window` `CustomEvent('nb:toast')`, which lets code that can't import the library (an inline script in a Blade view, say) raise one too.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | `ToastPosition` | `'bottom-right'` | screen corner/edge to anchor to |
| `order` | `ToastOrder` | `'newest-first'` | which end new items join |
| `animation` | `ToastAnimation` | `'slide'` | entry animation; slide follows `position` |
| `duration` | `number` | `5000` | default visible time in ms; per-toast `duration` wins |
| `max` | `number` | `4` | cap on visible items; the oldest are dismissed past it |
| `width` | `string` | `'24rem'` | max width of the stack |
| `stack` | `boolean` | `false` | collapse the queue into a pile; pointing at it expands |
| `disableSwipe` | `boolean` | `false` | turn off swipe-to-dismiss |
| `disableEvents` | `boolean` | `false` | stop listening for `nb:toast` window events |
| `label` | `string` | `'Notifications ({hotkey})'` | Screen-reader label for the viewport landmark. |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Toaster']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the viewport the toasts stack in |
| `toast` | each `Toast` |

**Motion:** `off`: toasts appear and leave instantly, the stack doesn't animate; `simple`: toasts fade in and out quickly; the stack jumps rather than glides; `smooth`: toasts slide in from their edge (or fade/scale, per `animation`) and fade out; the stack glides when toasts arrive or leave; `fancy`: springier, longer entries and a zoomed exit; the stack glides on a spring (override with `toast.move`).

### Tooltip

Tooltip component using Reka UI

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `string` | **required** | The tooltip content text |
| `side` | `TooltipSide` | `'top'` | The side where the tooltip appears (default: 'top') |
| `delayDuration` | `number` | `100` | Delay before tooltip shows in milliseconds (default: 700) |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the tooltip is disabled |
| `contentClass` | `string` | `''` | Deprecated, use `class` |
| `arrowClass` | `string` | `''` | Deprecated, use `:ui="{ arrow: '...' }"` |
| `sideOffset` | `number` | `4` | Distance from trigger in pixels (default: 4) |
| `collisionPadding` | `number` | `8` | Padding from viewport edges in pixels (default: 8) |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['Tooltip']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `content`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | the tooltip bubble; `class` and other attrs land here |
| `arrow` | the arrow |

**Motion:** `off`: opens and closes instantly; `simple`: quick fade in and out; `smooth`: fades in with a small slide away from the trigger, fades out; `fancy`: pops out of the trigger on a spring, zooms out on close.

### Tr

Renders a single row of a table and is the row primitive you fill with `Td` cells. Supports hover, `clickable` and `selectable` states plus success/warning/danger/info variants, emitting `click` and `select`. On narrow screens it collapses to a stacked card so each cell sits on its own line, and returns to a real `table-row` from `sm` up.

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<tr>` |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### TrCollapse

a full-width `colspan` cell whose content is revealed when a matching `TrCollapseHandler` or `TdCollapseHandler` with the same `collapse_id` is clicked. Toggling is done by Tailwind Elements' `data-te-collapse` behaviour, so the host app must have that initialised.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collapse_id` | `string` | - |  |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['TrCollapse']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<tr>` |
| `content` | the collapsing container inside the cell |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### TrCollapseHandler

Summary row that toggles the `TrCollapse` sharing its `collapse_id`, with the whole row acting as the trigger and carrying the `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` wiring. Use `TdCollapseHandler` instead when only one cell of the row should toggle it.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `collapse_id` | `string` | - |  |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['TrCollapseHandler']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<tr>` |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### TrPlaceholder

renders `placeholders` full-width rows containing a pulsing grey bar. `Tbody` inserts it automatically while data is loading or deferred, so you normally only use it directly when driving the loading state by hand.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placeholders` | `number` | - |  |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['TrPlaceholder']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `row`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `row` | each skeleton `<tr>` |
| `bar` | the pulsing bar |

**Motion:** all levels: the bar keeps pulsing at every level: it is a status indicator.

### UnderConstruction

Under Construction component A utility component to display a placeholder for sections that are still being developed. Shows a construction icon with customizable message.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `full` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to take full height (grows to fill container) |
| `info` | `string` | `'Section under construction.\nPlease come back later.'` | Custom message to display (supports line breaks with \n) |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['UnderConstruction']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the striped background |
| `card` | the white card |
| `icon` | the construction icon |
| `title` | the heading |
| `message` | the message text |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.

### WarningButton

Warning Button component

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | `'button'` | The button type (default: 'button') |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the button is disabled |
| `customClass` | `string` | `''` | Deprecated, use `class` |
| `size` | `keyof ButtonSizes` | `'md'` | Button size (default: 'md') |
| `ui` | `UiProp<NbParts['WarningButton']>` | - | Classes per part, merged over the defaults |
| `motion` | `MotionLevel` | - | Motion level for this instance |

**Slots:** `default`

**Parts** (`:ui` keys; `class` goes to `root`):

| Part | Element |
| --- | --- |
| `root` | the `<button>`, rendered by `Button`, so `ui.Button` config applies too |

**Motion:** all levels: only hover and focus colour transitions, which `off` makes instant.


---

# Page composition recipes

Each block below is a complete, working page pattern in `src/docs/Blocks/`. Read the file for the full markup;
every one contains a live demo and a `CodePreview` snippet that is the consumer-ready version.

### 2FA, OAuth & Passkeys

A two-factor challenge card: six auto-advancing single-character boxes that accept a pasted 6-digit code, a Verify button that stays disabled until the code is complete, and a toggle that swaps the boxes for a single recovery-code Input. Try 123456 for success, anything else to see the error.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/AuthSecurityBlock.vue`

Uses: `Input`, `Alert`, `PrimaryButton`, `NbIcon`, `InlineCode`, `Card`, `IconCircle`, `CodePreview`

### AI Assistant

A chat panel composed from TextInput, PrimaryButton and SecondaryButton: replies stream in word by word with a blinking cursor, an inline tool-call step expands to its raw result, and Stop aborts the stream while Regenerate replays the last answer.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/AiAssistantBlock.vue`

Uses: `Card`, `IconCircle`, `Badge`, `NbIcon`, `TextInput`, `SecondaryButton`, `PrimaryButton`, `CodePreview`

### App Navbar

A horizontal application header driven by a single navItems array: items with children render a Dropdown of DropdownLinks, the rest render a NavLink. The right side pairs GravatarImg with a user menu, and the hamburger re-renders the same array as NavCollapse + ResponsiveNavLink.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/NavbarBlock.vue`

Uses: `Dropdown`, `NbIcon`, `DropdownLink`, `NavLink`, `GravatarImg`, `DropdownSeparator`, `IconButton`, `NbTransition`, `NavCollapse`, `ResponsiveNavLink`, `InlineCode`, `CodePreview`

### Auth Pages

A registration card composed from Input and Checkbox, with a terms-of-service agreement and a link back to the login page.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/AuthPagesBlock.vue`

Uses: `Card`, `Input`, `Checkbox`, `PrimaryButton`, `Alert`, `EmptyState`, `SecondaryButton`, `CodePreview`, `InlineCode`

### Cards & Lists

A responsive team member grid built from GravatarImg avatars, an online status pill, and a kebab-triggered Dropdown for row actions.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/CardsGridBlock.vue`

Uses: `Card`, `GravatarImg`, `Dropdown`, `IconButton`, `DropdownLink`, `NbIcon`, `DropdownSeparator`, `Badge`, `IconCircle`, `CodePreview`

### Charts & Data Viz

Two series on a smooth-curve area chart with a gradient fill that fades to transparent. The toolbar and zoom are off, dashboard charts are read, not operated.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/ChartsBlock.vue`

Uses: `Card`, `InlineCode`, `CodePreview`, `NbIcon`

### Chat Interface

A two-person messenger: GravatarImg header with an online pill, a scrollable bubble pane with day divider and timestamps, an animated typing indicator, and a composer with an IconButton send. Sending scrolls the pane and triggers a canned reply.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/ChatBlock.vue`

Uses: `Card`, `GravatarImg`, `Badge`, `NbTransitionGroup`, `NbTransition`, `IconButton`, `CodePreview`

### CRUD Index Page

The canonical list screen: header action, Stats tiles doubling as filters, a search row, a Table with an actions column and empty state, Pagination, and a NewModal create form. Everything below is live: filter, search, delete and create rows.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/IndexPageBlock.vue`

Uses: `PageHeader`, `SecondaryButton`, `NbIcon`, `Stats`, `Input`, `Select`, `Table`, `Thead`, `Th`, `Tbody`, `Tr`, `Td`, `Badge`, `IconButton`, `NewModal`, `PrimaryButton`, `InlineCode`, `Pagination`, `CodePreview`

### Dashboard Overview

A dashboard landing composition: a KPI grid of DataTiles with icon chips and signed trends, a bar chart Card, and an activity feed panel. The chart is a flex row of rounded bars with pixel heights; no chart library is bundled with this package. Flip the Loading switch to see the skeleton cards and the Spinner-guarded chart; Clear empties the feed to its empty state.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/DashboardBlock.vue`

Uses: `Card`, `Skeleton`, `DataTile`, `Spinner`, `SecondaryButton`, `IconCircle`, `EmptyState`, `InlineCode`, `Switch`, `CodePreview`

### Empty & Error States

A basic EmptyState: icon, title, short description, and a single call-to-action button.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/EmptyStatesBlock.vue`

Uses: `EmptyState`, `PrimaryButton`, `NbIcon`, `SecondaryButton`, `LinkButton`, `InlineCode`, `CodePreview`

### Feeds & Timelines

A reverse-chronological activity feed: Timeline with layout="cards" gives each event a tinted row, an icon, a title with a right-aligned relative time, and a detail line. Map your own statuses to the colour variants.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/FeedTimelineBlock.vue`

Uses: `Timeline`, `Select`, `Badge`, `Card`, `EmptyState`, `InlineCode`, `CodePreview`

### Form Layouts

A centered login card composed from Input, Checkbox, and SecondaryButton, with a forgot-password link and a submit button disabled while the form is processing.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/FormsBlock.vue`

Uses: `Card`, `Input`, `Checkbox`, `SecondaryButton`, `Select`, `Textarea`, `PrimaryButton`, `CodePreview`

### Marketing Sections

A gradient hero band with an eyebrow pill, headline, supporting copy, and a CTA cluster, composed from PrimaryButton and SecondaryButton.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/MarketingBlock.vue`

Uses: `PrimaryButton`, `SecondaryButton`, `Card`, `IconCircle`, `NbIcon`, `CodePreview`, `InlineCode`

### Mega Menu

A horizontal navbar whose items open wide multi-column panels: two columns of icon-tile links with one-line descriptions plus a highlighted featured card. Built by hand rather than with Dropdown, because Dropdown portals its panel to the body and caps it at menu width, a mega panel needs to stay anchored to the bar and span its full width. Clicking outside the bar or on any link closes it.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/MegaMenuBlock.vue`

Uses: `NbIcon`, `NavLink`, `NbTransition`, `IconCircle`, `SecondaryButton`, `InlineCode`, `PrimaryButton`, `CodePreview`

### Modal Recipes

Five ready-made NewModal compositions: create form, export options, upload, danger confirm and a resizable dialog. Built from Input, RadioButton, Switch, FileDropZoneInput and the button family.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/ModalsBlock.vue`

Uses: `PrimaryButton`, `NbIcon`, `NewModal`, `Input`, `SecondaryButton`, `RadioButton`, `Switch`, `FileDropZoneInput`, `DangerButton`, `InlineCode`, `CodePreview`

### Multi-Step Form

A three-step wizard: a Stepper whose rails fill as you advance, over a single form split across Account, Company, and Review steps. Composes Input, Select, RadioButton, Checkbox, Alert, and the button pair, one useForm holds every field, and steps switch with v-if on a step ref.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/WizardBlock.vue`

Uses: `Stepper`, `Alert`, `Card`, `Input`, `Select`, `RadioButton`, `DescriptionList`, `DescriptionListItem`, `Checkbox`, `SecondaryButton`, `PrimaryButton`, `InlineCode`, `CodePreview`

### Orderable Fields

A drag-to-reorder list built on native HTML5 drag events, no library. Each row carries a grip handle and up/down IconButtons so the order is reachable by keyboard too. The dragged row dims, and the drop target shows a line where the item will land.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/OrderableBlock.vue`

Uses: `NbIcon`, `IconButton`, `Input`, `NbTransitionGroup`, `InlineCode`, `CodePreview`

### Page Shell

The page skeleton every app needs: a PageHeader bar (breadcrumbs plus right-aligned actions), a Card for the content, and a stack of Section components.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/PageShellBlock.vue`

Uses: `PageHeader`, `SecondaryButton`, `NbIcon`, `PrimaryButton`, `Card`, `Section`, `InlineCode`, `CodePreview`

### Product Page

An e-commerce product detail page: gallery with thumbnails, variant and size pickers, a quantity stepper, PrimaryButton / SecondaryButton actions that raise a real toast through Toaster, and a Tabs section holding the description, a Table of specifications and the review list.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/ProductPageBlock.vue`

Uses: `Breadcrumbs`, `Badge`, `IconButton`, `PrimaryButton`, `SecondaryButton`, `NbIcon`, `Tabs`, `Tab`, `Table`, `Thead`, `Th`, `Tbody`, `Tr`, `Td`, `Toaster`, `Card`, `CodePreview`

### Settings Page

A two-column account settings page: a vertical section nav on the left, and on the right a Section card per topic, each with its own form state and its own save button, so one save never submits the others. The Danger Zone card opens a NewModal that only enables its confirm button once you type DELETE.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/SettingsPageBlock.vue`

Uses: `Section`, `Input`, `Textarea`, `PrimaryButton`, `Checkbox`, `DangerButton`, `NewModal`, `SecondaryButton`, `InlineCode`, `NbTransition`, `CodePreview`

### Show & Edit Page

A CRUD resource page that swaps the whole page between a read view and an edit view. Read mode is a DescriptionList where every field carries a help line; edit mode turns the same fields into Input, Select and Textarea with the same help lines as hints. Cancelling with unsaved changes asks for confirmation in a NewModal.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/ShowEditBlock.vue`

Uses: `PageHeader`, `Badge`, `PrimaryButton`, `DangerButton`, `Alert`, `DescriptionList`, `DescriptionListItem`, `Input`, `Select`, `Textarea`, `SecondaryButton`, `NewModal`, `Card`, `NbIcon`, `CodePreview`

### Sidebar Navigation

A vertical app sidebar built from NavLink (with #icon slots) and NavCollapse groups. A single ref drives the open prop of every group, so only one group stays expanded at a time.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/SidebarBlock.vue`

Uses: `NavLink`, `NbIcon`, `NavCollapse`, `Input`, `IconButton`, `EmptyState`, `InlineCode`, `CodePreview`

### Skeletons & Loading

Skeleton primitives: a text-line stack, an avatar row with two supporting lines, and an image card built from a rect.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/SkeletonsBlock.vue`

Uses: `Skeleton`, `Card`, `Switch`, `Avatar`, `SubmitButton`, `InlineCode`, `CodePreview`

### Tabbed Detail Page

A record-detail page: a PageHeader with a status Badge and a destructive action, then a Section holding Tabs/Tab panes - an inline-edit DescriptionList bound to useForm() whose Save button only appears while the form is dirty, plus a Logs timeline.

Source: `src/docs/Blocks/TabbedDetailBlock.vue`

Uses: `PageHeader`, `Badge`, `DangerButton`, `NbIcon`, `Section`, `Tabs`, `Tab`, `SecondaryButton`, `DescriptionList`, `DescriptionListItem`, `Input`, `Logs`, `InlineCode`, `NbTransition`, `CodePreview`
